recommendation: Keep the fix. Future BackboneType datatype additions/removals should update both lists together or replace them with generated content.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction asking that the BackboneType datatype lists be complete and consistent, because datatypes allowing modifier extensions derive from BackboneType.
initial_application: Commit 5cbc14c7d0f361941099bf72066b75c3f74f6d4f applied the issue in R5 by adding Statistic and OrderedDistribution to source/types.html. Later commits removed those obsolete entries but did not keep the list synchronized with newer active BackboneType datatypes.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps the edited pages in build scope. Current active datatype roots based on BackboneType are Timing, RelativeTime, Dosage, DosageDetails, DosageSafety, DosageCondition, ProductShelfLife, MarketingStatus, and ElementDefinition. FHIR-50466 is related but unresolved and only concerns structure-table display.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes.html and source/types.html to list all active BackboneType datatypes and adjusted the source/types.html introductory sentence so it no longer implies only the old three-item set.
source_changes: source/datatypes.html: Added RelativeTime, DosageDetails, DosageSafety, DosageCondition, ProductShelfLife, and MarketingStatus to the modifier-extension datatype list.
source/types.html: Added the same active BackboneType datatypes and changed the lead-in from 'the few datatypes' to 'datatypes' to match the current source-derived set.

related_jiras.note: Earlier BackboneElement issue about datatype-specialization confusion; current BackboneType list is the successor location for datatype modifier-extension exceptions.
